title: Euphrasia officinalis tincture for medicinal use
intro: Euphrasia officinalis tincture is a concentrated herbal preparation made by soaking the dried leaves and flowers of the greater periwinkle plant in alcohol. It is commonly used in herbalism for its soothing effects on the eyes and respiratory system. This tincture is often employed to alleviate symptoms of eye strain, redness, and irritation. It may also support the treatment of respiratory conditions such as coughs and sore throats. Due to its mild and calming properties, it is generally considered safe for most adults when used as directed.
